title: No test passes the value of `Core\Secret::reveal()` into a spawn, a serialize call or a worker-placed spawn.
text: `rule:security/secret-crosses-no-boundary` covers a secret and what is revealed from it. The test at `crates/nvs-types/tests/secret.rs:142` uses a stand-in for the revealed value, and its comment describes code that has changed. Nothing passes a real `reveal()` result into `spawn`, into `Core\Serialize`, or into a spawn placed on another worker. Closing it means one case for each of the three, with the outcome the rule states, and the test's comment rewritten.
